title: manual/v1 body
description: A screen manual: the steps a person takes on one screen, each with a capture. The screen is not a body field but the envelope's one links[] entry with rel "screen" (a screen-map document); activation requires it. A capture is named by the sha256 of its bytes in the asset store (store/assets/<sha256>), and an active manual may only name captures that are there. The id is authored in the envelope — a title is prose, not an identifier.

title.description: What the manual achieves, as people would ask for it. Rendered as the md heading, so one line and no leading markdown block marker.

asset.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the capture in the asset store.
